## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `mailchimp-marketing-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Log in to your Mailchimp account

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your Mailchimp account at [login.mailchimp.com](https://login.mailchimp.com/). -->
2. <!-- manual: Select your profile icon in the bottom-left corner to open the account menu. -->

## Step 3: Generate an API key

1. In the account menu, go to the **Extras** section and select **API keys**.
2. Select **Create A Key** (not the Mandrill API key). You are redirected to the API key dashboard.
3. Enter a name for your API key and select **Generate Key**.
4. <!-- manual: Enter a name for your API key and select Generate Key. -->
5. <!-- manual: Copy the generated API key immediately — it will not be shown again. -->
